article_content: Next time you log in to Pinterest, you might encounter boards filled with spam images of women in underwear or bare buttocks. These images—some front-facing, others showing exposed or clothed rear views—are replacing legitimate pins across multiple accounts. Each is accompanied by captions promoting weight-loss products or fake giveaways. Reports of the incident first emerged on Twitter last night. Users, including startup expert Hermione Way and TechCrunch co-editor Alexia Tsotsis, shared screenshots showing their feeds overrun with inappropriate content. Way tweeted: 'Dear @Pinterest, my account has been hacked—someone is posting hundreds of butt pictures all over my boards. Security??!' The Council of Better Business Bureaus issued a warning earlier this month about rising spam levels on Pinterest. Pinterest has acknowledged the issue and confirmed it is investigating. However, the breach does not originate from Pinterest’s own platform. Instead, hackers are infiltrating third-party websites that host the 'Pin this' button—commonly embedded on blogs and news articles—and injecting malicious code that swaps legitimate images with spam. When a user clicks the 'Pin this' button on an infected site, the code redirects the pin to a spam image hosted elsewhere. Pinterest does not automatically remove these pins, but users can report them by clicking the flag icon beneath each image. To protect yourself: change your password if you suspect compromise, avoid linking your Pinterest account to other social media, only log in through official channels (Pinterest.com or the verified mobile app), and hover over pins to verify destination links before repinning. In addition, some attackers are creating fake Pinterest boards designed as phishing traps to steal access to connected Facebook accounts. This follows a pattern seen on other platforms, such as Twitter, where recent incidents involved mass-following bots and password resets reportedly triggered by software bugs—not direct hacks.
translated_content: 다음에 핀터레스트에 로그인할 때 속옷을 입은 여성들의 이미지나 벌거벗은 엉덩이가 가득한 보드를 마주칠 수 있습니다. 이러한 이미지들은 일부 사용자의 보드에서 정상적인 핀을 대체하며, 각각은 체중 감량 제품이나 가짜 경품을 홍보하는 캡션을 달고 있습니다. 이 사건에 대한 보고는 지난 밤 트위터에서 처음 나타났습니다. 스타트업 전문가 헤르미온느 웨이와 테크크런치 공동 편집장 알렉시아 톱시스를 포함한 사용자들이 자신의 피드가 부적절한 콘텐츠로 뒤덮인 스크린샷을 공유했습니다. 웨이는 트윗으로 이렇게 말했습니다: '@Pinterest님, 제 계정이 해킹당했습니다. 누군가 제 보드 전체에 수백 장의 엉덩이 사진을 올리고 있습니다. 보안은요?!' 좋은 비즈니스 국 협의회는 이달 초 핀터레스트에서 스팸이 급증하고 있다고 경고했습니다. 핀터레스트는 이 문제를 인지했으며 조사 중임을 확인했습니다. 그러나 이 침해는 핀터레스트 자체 플랫폼에서 발생한 것이 아닙니다. 대신 해커들은 블로그 및 뉴스 기사에 일반적으로 탑재된 '이것을 핀하기' 버튼을 호스팅하는 제3자 웹사이트에 침투하여 정상 이미지를 스팸으로 교체하는 악성 코드를 삽입하고 있습니다. 사용자가 감염된 사이트의 '이것을 핀하기' 버튼을 클릭하면, 코드는 해당 핀을 외부에 호스팅된 스팸 이미지로 리디렉션합니다. 핀터레스트는 이러한 핀을 자동으로 삭제하지 않지만, 사용자는 이미지 아래의 플래그 아이콘을 클릭하여 신고할 수 있습니다. 자신을 보호하려면: 의심되는 경우 비밀번호를 변경하고, 핀터레스트 계정을 다른 소셜 미디어와 연결하지 마세요. 공식 채널(Pinterest.com 또는 검증된 모바일 앱)에서만 로그인하고, 다시 핀하기 전에 이미지 위에 마우스를 올려 링크 목적지를 확인하세요. 또한 일부 공격자는 연결된 페이스북 계정에 접근하려는 피싱 트랩으로 가짜 핀터레스트 보드를 만들고 있습니다. 이는 최근 트위터에서도 관찰된 패턴과 유사합니다. 트위터에서는 대규모 팔로우 봇과 소프트웨어 버그로 인해 비밀번호 재설정이 발생했다고 보고되었습니다. 직접 해킹은 아니었습니다.

article_content: By John Stevens in Memphis. A royal fan was stopped by U.S. Secret Service officers after approaching the private residence where the Duke of Cambridge and Prince Harry were staying. Beverly McPhail, a 29-year-old woman who is 15 weeks pregnant, traveled from Orlando, Florida, to Memphis to catch a glimpse of the princes during their attendance at the wedding of their close friend, Guy Pelly, to Elizabeth Wilson. On Friday, McPhail was observed outside the Memphis Country Club—the venue for the rehearsal dinner—where she was approached by security personnel. Local TV reporter Katie Rufener captured the encounter, noting: 'Security is extremely tight. The Secret Service questioned a woman taking photos near the estate where the royals are staying.' McPhail, who made the 750-mile journey after learning of the wedding six months prior, insisted she was not a stalker. 'I’d call myself a royal watcher,' she told MailOnline. 'I didn’t go onto the property—I was just outside.' She added: 'They were very nice, but they’ve made me nervous. I didn’t do anything wrong.' McPhail traveled with her mother-in-law, Sheryl, 58. She said she had previously attended the 2011 royal wedding in London and viewed this trip as a natural extension of her long-standing admiration for the royal family, inspired by Princess Diana. Security around the princes has been extensive since their arrival in the U.S. Their visit to Graceland included a ten-vehicle motorcade. At Rendezvous BBQ, nearly an entire city block was cordoned off for their entourage. While the princes cover their own travel and accommodation costs, they are protected around the clock by a team of approximately four officers from Scotland Yard’s Royalty Protection Squad, funded by British taxpayers. Estimated total security costs for the five-day trip are around $84,000, including accommodations and business-class flights for the protective detail. Retired Chief Superintendent Dai Davies, former head of Royal Protection, defended the measures: 'William is the future king, and Harry is fourth in line to the throne and a serving military officer. Unfortunately, that makes them high-value targets. Continuous protection is non-negotiable.'

article_content: An investigation has been launched after a social worker mistakenly took four-year-old Kenzie Joe Jubb from his nursery class at Francis Askew Primary School in Hull, East Yorkshire. Kenzie was wrongly identified as the child scheduled for a supervised visit with his father and was taken — along with a two-year-old girl, whom staff incorrectly believed to be his sister — to social services offices. He was away from his classroom for more than 10 minutes before educators realized the error. Kenzie, who has no connection to social services, was transported in a car by a stranger who told him he would meet his dad and see a dog. His father, Alistair Jubb, expressed outrage, calling the incident 'horrific' and demanding a full explanation of how such a mistake could occur. The school immediately contacted Hull City Council’s Safeguarding Children Board upon discovering the error. Both institutions have since apologized to the family and confirmed a joint investigation is underway. Mr. Jubb noted that school staff have reviewed policies and committed to changes, including ensuring children are only released to known personnel. Hull City Council emphasized that all staff involved undergo enhanced background checks (DBS) and carry identification — yet the misidentification still occurred. John Readman, Director of Children’s Services, stated: 'This incident should not have occurred. While the child was always supervised, we must understand how this failure happened and ensure procedures are rigorously followed in the future.'

article_content: At least 17 people were killed when inmates attempted to escape from a prison in northern Mexico on Tuesday, firing guns at guard towers and using tunnels beneath the facility. The dead included 11 inmates and six guards, according to Durango state public safety officials. The violence erupted around 5 p.m. Tuesday at Cereso No. 2 prison in the city of Gomez Palacio, when inmates began rioting and opened fire, officials said. 'The inmates started shooting firearms at guard towers and guard areas,' the statement read. Officials said the clashes occurred as guards tried to stop what they described as a 'massive prison break.' Guards initially fired warning shots into the air to contain the riot, but exchanged gunfire after the inmates did not respond. Military troops intervened and stopped the attempted escape. Authorities are investigating to determine who was responsible. Violence has been frequently reported at this prison. In a previous incident last year, 11 inmates were killed. In July 2010, Mexico’s Attorney General’s Office alleged that inmates from Cereso No. 2 were released in police vehicles to carry out a targeted killing at a birthday party, which left 17 dead. Top prison officials were named as suspects in that case. The prison’s former director and 10 others were later convicted and are now serving sentences in federal prisons across Mexico. CNN Mexico and CNN en Español’s Karina Maciel contributed to this report.

article_content: Washington (CNN) — Drawing on firsthand experiences of living with the threat of radioactive contamination, several Japanese citizens affected by the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear disaster have traveled to Washington to urge U.S. officials to recognize nuclear energy as an unacceptable risk. In March 2011, a massive earthquake and tsunami triggered meltdowns in three operating reactors at Fukushima, leading to widespread radiation leaks and long-term environmental contamination. Sachiko Sato, a farmer from Fukushima, arrived in Washington with her two teenage children. 'I come from Fukushima,' she said. 'Radiation has altered this once-unchanged landscape — but it’s still here.' Though her English was imperfect, her anguish was unmistakable. At a press conference, Sato questioned why the Japanese government raised radiation safety thresholds — effectively disqualifying her farm from financial aid. 'Did they think people’s bodies suddenly became more resistant to radiation after the accident?' she asked. Her children described constant fear of future health consequences from exposure. Yukiko Anzai, an organic beekeeper whose honey production depends on uncontaminated land, said she and her husband may be forced to abandon farming altogether. 'We farmed for the health and happiness of others — now we’re struggling to survive,' she told reporters. Sato and Anzai are part of a broader coalition of Japanese activists opposing nuclear power. They met with U.S. congressional staff and officials from the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission to share their stories and advocate for stronger global nuclear safety standards. As of 2011, Japan had 11 reactors operating and 43 temporarily shut down for maintenance. Aileen Mioko Smith of Green Action noted that if none were restarted, all could be offline by March 2012. But she acknowledged the government intended to resume operations. Activists point to Germany’s decision to phase out nuclear power entirely within a decade as proof that change is possible. In contrast, the U.S. and other Western nations continue to support nuclear energy, pending safety reviews. Kaori Izumi, who is actively resisting reactor restarts in Japan, emphasized the moral imperative of learning from tragedy. 'There is immense suffering in Fukushima — in families like Mrs. Sato’s. Their pain only has meaning if we truly learn from it,' she said. Citing Three Mile Island, Chernobyl, and now Fukushima, she added, 'Can we afford not to learn? I don’t think so.'
translated_content: 워싱턴(CNN) — 후쿠시마 원전 사고의 직접 피해자들이 방사능 오염 위협에 대한 경험을 바탕으로 미국 관계자들에게 핵 에너지가 받아들일 수 없는 위험임을 설득하기 위해 워싱턴을 방문했습니다. 2011년 3월, 거대한 지진과 쓰나미로 인해 후쿠시마 원전에서 세 개의 원자로가 용융되며 광범위한 방사능 유출과 장기적인 환경 오염이 발생했습니다. 후쿠시마 출신 농부 사치코 사토는 두 명의 십대 자녀와 함께 워싱턴을 방문했습니다. 그녀는 말했습니다. '후쿠시마에는 사토 부인을 비롯한 가족들의 엄청난 고통이 있습니다. 그들의 고통이 의미를 가지려면 우리는 진정으로 이 교훈을 배워야 합니다.' 그녀는 펜실베이니아의 스리마일 아일랜드, 우크라이나의 체르노빌, 그리고 지금의 후쿠시마를 언급하며 말했습니다. '우리는 배우지 않을 수 있을까요? 저는 그렇지 않다고 생각합니다.'

article_content: Inter Milan took a crucial step toward making history by defeating 10-man rivals Roma 1-0 in the Italian Cup final on Wednesday night. Diego Milito’s 40th-minute strike — his 26th goal of the season — proved decisive, giving manager José Mourinho his second trophy since arriving at the club two years ago. The Argentine forward capitalized on a precise pass from Thiago Motta, shrugging off a challenge before firing past Roma keeper Julio Sergio. Roma, who last won the cup in 2008, were reduced to 10 men in the 88th minute after captain Francesco Totti, who came on as a substitute at halftime, received his second yellow card within 25 minutes. Mourinho’s early substitution paid off when Dutch midfielder Wesley Sneijder exited injured in the fifth minute, paving the way for young striker Mario Balotelli to enter the game. Milito had earlier seen a goal disallowed for offside in the 17th minute. Meanwhile, in France, Marseille claimed their first Ligue 1 title in 18 years with a 3-1 home win over Rennes. The result extended their lead to eight points atop the table with two matches remaining. Lille secured second place on goal difference after a 2-0 away victory at Toulouse, while Auxerre slipped to third following a 2-1 defeat at Lyon.

article_content: Los Angeles (CNN) — Joseph Ruskin, who acted in 25 films and 124 television shows, died of natural causes at a Santa Monica, California, hospital on Saturday, SAG-AFTRA announced Tuesday. He was 89. Ruskin’s film credits include roles in 'The Magnificent Seven,' 'Prizzi's Honor,' 'Indecent Proposal,' and 'Smokin' Aces.' His television roles spanned 'The Twilight Zone,' 'Star Trek,' 'Mission: Impossible,' and 'Alias.' He began and ended his acting career on the stage. His first professional performances were at the Pittsburgh Playhouse and the Rochester Arena Stage after leaving the U.S. Navy following World War II. His final theater performance came this year as a member of the Antaeus Theatre Company of Los Angeles — appearing in the 2012 production of 'You Can't Take It With You' and taking his final bow in 2013 in the company’s production of 'The Crucible.' 'Joe was the epitome of the actor who takes care of all the other actors while keeping one foot firmly planted on the stage or the set,' said SAG-AFTRA President Ken Howard. 'He gave so much for so long, it's hard to believe he's gone.' Ruskin devoted much of his time in the 1980s to the merger of SAG and AFTRA, which became official in 2012, Howard noted. He served on the Screen Actors Guild board from 1976 to 1999, including eight years as First National Vice President, according to the SAG-AFTRA release. He was the first Western Regional Vice President of Actors Equity Association and served a decade on AFTRA’s national board. Ruskin, whose real name was Joseph Schlafman, was born in Haverhill, Massachusetts, but attended high school in Cleveland, Ohio. He joined the Navy in 1942 and studied drama at Carnegie Tech — now Carnegie Mellon University — after the war, launching his professional acting career.
translated_content: 로스앤젤레스(CNN) — 조셉 러스킨은 영화 25편과 텔레비전 프로그램 124편에 출연한 배우로, 토요일 캘리포니아 산타모니카의 한 병원에서 자연사로 사망했다고 SAG-AFTRA가 화요일 발표했다. 향년 89세. 러스킨의 영화 출연작으로는 '매그니피센트 세븐', '프리지의 영광', '인디센트 프로포즈', '스모큰 에이시스'가 있으며, 텔레비전 출연작으로는 '더 트와일라잇 존', '스타트렉', '미션: 임파서블', '앨리어스'가 있다. 그는 무대에서 연기 경력을 시작해 무대에서 마무리했다. 제2차 세계대전 후 미 해군을 전역한 후 피츠버그 플레이하우스와 로체스터 아레나 스테이지에서 첫 전문 무대 무대를 밟았다. 그의 마지막 연극 무대는 올해 로스앤젤레스의 안테우스 극단에서 '너는 그것을 가질 수 없다'의 2012년 공연에 참여했으며, 2013년 같은 극단의 '크루시블' 공연에서 마지막 인사를 나누었다. SAG-AFTRA 회장 켄 하워드는 '조는 무대나 촬영장에 발을 딛고 있는 동시에 다른 배우들을 돌보는 진정한 배우의 본보기였다. 그는 오랫동안 이렇게 많은 것을 주었으니, 그가 떠났다는 게 믿기지 않는다.'고 말했다. 하워드는 러스킨이 1980년대에 SAG와 AFTRA의 합병에 많은 시간을 바쳤으며, 이는 2012년에 실현되었다고 밝혔다. 그는 1976년부터 1999년까지 스크린 액터스 길드 이사회에 재직했고, 그 중 8년간 제1부회장을 지냈다. 또한 그는 액터스 이쿼티 협회의 최초 서부 지역 부회장이었고, AFTRA 국가이사회에 10년간 재직했다. 러스킨의 본명은 조셉 슬라프만이며, 매사추세츠주 헤버릴에서 태어났지만 오하이오주 클리블랜드에서 고등학교를 다녔다. 그는 1942년에 해군에 입대했고, 전쟁 후 카네기 기술대학(현재 카네기 멜론 대학교)에서 연기를 공부하며 전문 연기자 경력을 시작했다.

article_content: One of the secrets to Frank Maloney’s success — though not the biggest, as it turns out — was that he was one of the lads. A cheeky South Londoner and a tough-nut Millwall fan, he regularly celebrated victories as manager of world heavyweight champion Lennox Lewis with nights out at venues euphemistically called gentlemen’s clubs. The deep loyalty characteristic of working-class road warriors was central to Maloney’s strong bonds with Lewis and all the boxers in his stable. Ecstatic after guiding Lennox Lewis to the World Heavyweight title in 1997, Maloney stood proudly by his side. Later, in photos from 1989, he is seen with a young Lewis. Maloney was both a promoter and manager, working with fighters including Lennox Lewis, David Haye, David Price, Rendall Munroe, John McDermott, Julius Francis, and Jon Lewis Dickinson. They trusted him, felt safe confiding in him, and some overachieved because his belief in them never wavered. He managed and promoted them with passionate machismo, fighting their corners as fiercely as they fought in the ring. So no, I did not see this coming — and I doubt anyone outside Maloney’s closest family did either. Frank — or Kellie, as she now wishes to be known — is a good friend, an entertaining dinner companion, and a brilliant boxing mind who will remain so. The 'Mental Midget' — a nickname coined by legendary US promoter Don King during one of their feuds — was always a larger-than-life character. Now, with the Union Jack suit replaced by female attire, her presence will undoubtedly draw attention — perhaps even fascination. Maloney’s effervescent sense of humor will help her navigate the inevitable, sometimes morbid, curiosity. Once the initial shock of her transition subsides, she’ll likely laugh along with the social media jokes already circulating. Her greatest concern remains the fallout for her three beloved daughters from two marriages. Maloney was initially criticized for bringing Lewis back to his London birthplace from Canada — where he grew up and won his Olympic gold medal. But as Maloney predicted, Britain welcomed its first world heavyweight champion in over a century. Her persuasiveness even convinced Americans to believe in Lewis — so much so that Riddick Bowe, the man who had dethroned Evander Holyfield, chose to abandon his WBC title rather than defend it in London. Over 12 years, Maloney guided Lewis to the undisputed world championship. Lennox remains the most recent heavyweight to hold that distinction. Maloney’s negotiating prowess, combined with Lewis’s power and talent, forged one of British boxing’s most successful partnerships. Their friendship endured after their professional split in 2001. She also guided Haye to his first world title at cruiserweight before he moved up to heavyweight, and helped Scott Harrison and Paul Ingle reach similar heights. Dozens of British champions passed through her orbit. She appeared poised to guide another domestic heavyweight, David Price, to a world title — until Price suffered back-to-back knockout losses to American Tony Thompson. Maloney had advised against Price rushing into that rematch. Shortly after, in October, Price announced his retirement: 'I’ve fallen out of love with boxing and no longer feel I can give it my best.' Now we understand there were deeper struggles haunting one of boxing’s most popular figures. Perhaps her increasing retreat from the family home in Kent to a second residence in Portugal hinted at an internal crisis — but no one suspected gender dysphoria, hormone therapy, or plans for transition. There were no signs of discomfort at public events. When Maloney was named Promoter of the Year by the Boxing Writers’ Association of America — among her many honors — I traveled to New York to present the award. She received heartfelt applause from the sport’s biggest stars. The 'special bond' she shared with champions like Julius Francis, the late James Oyebola, Rendall Munroe, and Graham Earl — 'they gave me some of my favorite nights in the ring' — survived a heart attack five years ago. As this 61-year-old begins a new, profoundly different chapter, she may find more support from the tough world of boxing than she expects right now.
translated_content: 프랭크 말로니의 성공 비밀 중 하나 — 하지만 가장 큰 비밀은 아니었음이 밝혀졌다 —는 그가 일개 '동료'였다는 것이었다. 남부 런던 출신의 장난기 가득한 청년이자 밀월 팬으로, 그는 세계 헤비급 챔피언 레녹스 루이스를 지도할 때마다 흔히 '남성 전용 클럽'이라 불리는 장소에서 친구들과 함께 밤을 보냈다. 노동계층의 로드 와리어들에게 흔히 나타나는 충성심은 말로니가 루이스와 자신의 스테이블에 속한 모든 복싱 선수들과 맺은 단단한 관계의 핵심이었다. 1997년 레녹스 루이스를 세계 헤비급 챔피언으로 이끈 후, 말로니는 기쁨에 차 그 옆에 서 있었다. 1989년 사진에서는 젊은 루이스와 함께 있는 모습이 보인다. 말로니는 프로모터이자 매니저로, 레녹스 루이스, 데이비드 헤이, 데이비드 프라이스, 렌달 무너, 존 맥더먼트, 줄리어스 프랜시스, 존 루이스 딕슨 등과 일했다. 선수들은 그를 신뢰했고, 그에게 안전하게 마음을 열었으며, 그의 믿음이 결코 흔들리지 않았기에 일부는 본인의 잠재력을 넘어서 성취했다. 그는 열정적인 마키시즘으로 선수들을 관리하고 프로모션했고, 그들이 링 안에서 싸우듯이 그들의 편을 뜨겁게 지켰다. 그래서, 나는 전혀 예상하지 못했다. 그리고 말로니의 가장 가까운 가족 외에는 누구도 예상하지 못했을 것이다. 프랭크 — 이제는 켈리라고 불리기를 원하는 그녀 —는 좋은 친구이자 즐거운 저녁 동반자이며, 여전히 가치 있는 복싱 애호가일 것이다. '정신적 아이돌'이라는 레전드 미국 프로모터 돈 킹이 한 번의 갈등에서 붙인 별명처럼, 그는 항상 인상적인 인물이었다. 이제 루이스와 데이비드 헤이의 경기에서 입었던 유나이티드 킹덤 깃발 무늬 정장을 여성복으로 바꾸면서, 그녀의 존재는 분명 주목을 받을 것이며, 어쩌면 이상한 호기심의 대상이 될지도 모른다. 말로니의 활력 넘치는 유머 감각은 이 의도치 않은, 때로는 부패한 호기심을 견뎌내는 데 도움이 될 것이다. 성전환에 대한 초기 충격이 가라앉으면, 그녀는 소셜 미디어에서 이미 퍼지고 있는 웃긴 농담에도 함께 웃을 것 같다. 그녀가 가장 우려하는 것은 두 번의 결혼을 통해 얻은 세 명의 사랑하는 딸들에게 미칠 영향이다. 말로니는 루이스를 캐나다에서 — 그가 성장하고 올림픽 금메달을 획득한 나라 — 런던 출생지로 데려왔다는 이유로 처음엔 비판받았다. 그러나 말로니의 예측대로, 영국은 수십 년 만에 첫 세계 헤비급 챔피언을 맞이했다. 그녀의 설득력은 미국인들도 루이스를 믿게 만들었고, 그 결과 엘리자베스 홀리필드를 몰아낸 릴리크 보우는 자신이 지닌 WBC 타이틀을 버리고도 런던에서 방어하지 않기로 결정했다. 12년간 말로니는 루이스를 통합 세계 챔피언으로 이끌었다. 레녹스는 여전히 마지막으로 이 타이틀을 보유한 헤비급 선수다. 말로니의 교섭 능력과 루이스의 뛰어난 재능과 파워가 영국 복싱 역사상 가장 성공적인 파트너십 중 하나를 만들어냈다. 그들의 우정은 2001년 프로페셔널 관계가 끝난 후에도 지속되었다. 그녀는 또한 헤이를 크루저급 세계 챔피언으로 이끌었고, 이후 헤이가 헤비급으로 진출하는 데 도움을 주었으며, 스콧 해리슨과 폴 인글도 비슷한 성공을 거두도록 도왔다. 수십 명의 영국 챔피언이 그녀의 손을 거쳤다. 그녀는 또 다른 영국 헤비급 선수인 데이비드 프라이스를 세계 타이틀에 올릴 준비를 하고 있었지만, 프라이스는 미국의 토니 톰슨에게 연속으로 TKO 패배를 당했다. 말로니는 프라이스가 재경기를 앞당기는 것을 반대했고, 곧 10월, 프라이스는 은퇴를 발표했다: '복싱에 대한 사랑을 잃었고, 더 이상 최선을 다할 수 없다고 느낀다.' 이제 우리는 복싱계에서 가장 인기 있던 인물 중 한 명이 숨겨둔 더 깊은 내적 갈등이 있었음을 알게 되었다. 그녀가 켄트의 가정집에서 포르투갈의 두 번째 집으로 점점 더 자주 떠나기 시작한 것은 내적 위기를 시사했을 수 있지만, 아무도 성 정체성 혼란, 호르몬 요법, 혹은 성전환 수술 계획을 의심하지 않았다. 공공장소나 사회적 모임에서 불편한 행동은 전혀 없었다. 말로니가 미국 복싱 기자 협회로부터 '올해의 프로모터'로 선정되었을 때 — 여러 개인 상 중 가장 중요한 상 중 하나 — 나는 뉴욕으로 가서 상을 전달했고, 그녀는 미국 복싱계의 가장 큰 이름들로부터 따뜻한 박수를 받았다. 줄리어스 프랜시스, 고인 제임스 오예볼라, 렌달 무너, 그레이엄 아일 등 국내 챔피언들과 그녀가 말한 '특별한 유대감'은 5년 전 심장마비를 겪은 후에도 유지되었다. 이제 61세의 그녀가 완전히 새로운 삶을 시작하며, 그녀가 이 순간에 상상하는 것보다 훨씬 더 많은 지원을 복싱계에서 받을 가능성이 높다.

article_content: New York (CNN) — City Council Speaker Christine Quinn, one of the leading candidates in New York City’s fiercely contested mayoral race, secured a major victory Thursday as the City Council overrode Mayor Michael Bloomberg’s veto of a bill she co-sponsored to establish an inspector general for the NYPD. The decision comes amid heightened scrutiny of NYPD practices following months of public outcry over racial profiling and racially charged controversies — particularly surrounding the stop-and-frisk policy, which has sparked intense political debate and a landmark federal lawsuit. The legislation, originally introduced in June, creates an independent inspector general with authority to investigate, review, and recommend changes to NYPD operations and policies. It also establishes a public complaint bureau to report misconduct or deficiencies. Bloomberg vetoed the bill in July, arguing that stop-and-frisk has helped reduce crime and that the new measures would hinder police effectiveness — potentially worsening crime in high-crime neighborhoods. In a statement following the override, Bloomberg claimed the legislation was not about curbing racial profiling — which he said is already illegal — but rather about political gain. 'It is a dangerous piece of legislation,' he said, 'and we will ask the courts to intervene before innocent people are harmed.' Quinn responded, 'Today’s vote is an historic step in the right direction to bring much-needed reform to the city’s stop-and-frisk program and begin building greater bridges between our police department and communities of color.' The Council also overrode Bloomberg’s veto of a second bill designed to explicitly prohibit bias-based profiling and provide legal recourse for victims — though Quinn voted against it, reportedly due to concerns over a specific provision. Earlier this month, U.S. District Judge Shira A. Scheindlin ruled that the NYPD’s stop-and-frisk policy violated the Fourth Amendment (unreasonable searches) and the Fourteenth Amendment (equal protection), citing data showing over 200,000 stops between 2004 and June 2012 lacked reasonable suspicion and disproportionately targeted Black and Hispanic individuals. NYPD Commissioner Ray Kelly called the judge’s findings 'disturbing and offensive,' asserting, 'We do not engage in racial profiling. It is prohibited by law. We train our officers that they need reasonable suspicion to make a stop, and I can assure you that race is never a reason to conduct a stop.' The reforms are set to take effect on January 1.
translated_content: 뉴욕(CNN) — 뉴욕시 시의회 의장 크리스틴 퀸은 뉴욕시에서 치열한 시장 선거에 출마한 주요 후보 중 한 명으로, 목요일 시의회가 마이클 블룸버그 시장이 반대했던 뉴욕경찰국(NYPD)에 감사관을 설치하는 법안의 거부권을 극복하면서 중요한 승리를 거뒀다. 이 결정은 최근 몇 달 동안 인종 프로파일링과 인종적 긴장이 심화된 가운데 내려졌으며, 특히 경찰의 '정지·검색' 정책이 정치적 논쟁과 역사적인 연방 소송의 중심에 서 있다. 6월에 도입된 이 법안은 NYPD의 운영, 정책 및 프로그램을 조사하고 검토하며 권고할 수 있는 독립적인 감사관을 설립하고, 시민들이 NYPD의 부당 행위나 문제점을 신고할 수 있는 민원실도 새로 설치한다. 블룸버그 시장은 7월 이 법안을 거부하며, '정지·검색' 정책이 범죄율 감소에 기여했고, 새로운 조치들은 경찰의 업무 수행을 방해하여 범죄가 많은 지역에서 범죄가 더 악화될 수 있다고 주장했다. 투표 결과 발표 후 블룸버그는 '이 법안은 이미 불법인 인종 프로파일링을 막기 위한 것이 아니라, 투표를 얻기 위한 정치적 목적이다. 위험한 법안이며, 무고한 사람들이 피해를 입기 전에 법원이 개입해야 한다'고 밝혔다. 퀸은 '오늘의 투표는 뉴욕시의 정지·검색 제도에 필요한 개혁을 이끌고 경찰과 색인 커뮤니티 간의 관계를 개선하는 데 있어 역사적인 진전이다'라고 말했다. 의회는 또한 인종적 편견 기반 프로파일링을 명시적으로 금지하고 피해자에게 법적 구제 길을 열어주는 또 다른 법안에 대한 블룸버그의 거부권을 극복했다. 그러나 퀸은 해당 법안의 특정 조항에 대한 우려로 반대 투표를 했다. 이달 초 미국 연방 판사 시라 A. 쉐인들린은 NYPD의 정지·검색 정책이 제4차 개정조항(부당한 수색)과 제14차 개정조항(평등한 보호)을 위반했다고 판결했다. 2004년부터 2012년 6월까지 무단으로 이루어진 20만 건 이상의 정지 사례가 증거로 제출되었으며, 이는 흑인과 히스패닉 계층에 불균형적으로 집중되었다. NYPD의 레이 켈리 위원장은 판사의 판단을 '망가지고 불쾌하다'고 표현하며, '우리는 인종 프로파일링을 하지 않는다. 그것은 법률로 금지되어 있다. 경찰은 정지에 필요한 합리적 의심을 갖도록 교육받으며, 인종은 절대 정지의 이유가 되지 않는다'고 강조했다. 이 개혁 조치는 1월 1일부터 시행된다.

article_content: In a bold act of civil disobedience, nearly 90 Greenpeace activists infiltrated France’s Fessenheim nuclear power plant — the nation’s oldest — early this morning, demanding its immediate shutdown. Clad in bright gear and riding inflatable boats along the Rhine, they scaled the facility’s dome and unfurled massive banners reading 'Stop Risking Europe.' Within hours, hundreds of police officers responded, arresting 34 of the protesters. Authorities confirmed no disruption to plant operations, and EDF, the state-backed utility managing the site, emphasized its continued safe functioning. Built in the late 1970s and situated near the Swiss border in eastern France, Fessenheim has long drawn criticism over its structural vulnerability, particularly after the 2011 Fukushima disaster. While President François Hollande has committed to closing the plant by 2016, Greenpeace insists waiting is unacceptable. 'These reactors are ticking time bombs,' said a spokesperson. 'We can’t afford another nuclear gamble.' The protest is part of a broader European campaign targeting aging nuclear facilities. Just last summer, 30 activists were detained after entering EDF’s Tricastin plant in southern France. Meanwhile, EDF is moving forward with plans to construct new reactors at Hinkley Point in England — a move environmental groups fiercely oppose. In a stark contrast to the relatively orderly French arrests, Greenpeace highlighted the ordeal of 28 activists detained by Russian forces in 2013 after protesting Arctic oil drilling. Seized aboard their ship, the Arctic Sunrise, the group was held in a rat-infested Murmansk prison, denied contact with family, and falsely accused of piracy. One detainee, Faiza Oulahsen, described rats crawling across her cell floor; another, Alexandra Harris, communicated with fellow prisoners by tapping on radiators during 23-hour solitary confinement. After global outcry — including appeals from 11 Nobel laureates — charges were downgraded to hooliganism and all were released after two months. Greenpeace argues that aging nuclear plants pose unacceptable risks to public health and the environment, and that continuing to invest in nuclear energy diverts resources from safer renewables. Yet critics note that nuclear remains a major low-carbon power source in Europe — providing 75% of France’s electricity — and that replacing it entirely will require massive infrastructure investment.

article_content: In today’s digital age, we spend far more time typing emails, texts, and tweets than writing letters by hand — making handwritten notes a rare sight. But in an unexpected twist, digital technology may be the very thing that saves the art of handwriting. Meet 'Bond': a robotic system that blends MakerBot 3D printers, Montblanc pens, and a mobile app to produce authentic cursive handwriting. Users begin by uploading a sample of their handwriting online. Bond’s software analyzes the unique way each letter is formed — including stroke direction, slant, and spacing. Afterward, customers select a blank card from the Bond website and type the message they’d like delivered. One of eleven Bond robots then uses a real pen, precisely controlled by a 3D printer, to write the message by hand on the card before mailing it directly to the recipient. For those who prefer, Bond also offers the option to mimic someone else’s handwriting — say, a loved one’s script — rather than their own. To achieve authenticity, the robot replicates subtle human nuances: variable pressure on letter joins, the delicate dot of an ‘i,’ and careful avoidance of smudges. As Sonny Caberwal, Bond’s founder and CEO, told Fast Company: 'Nobody ever says, “You know what’s awesome? I had the best experience at American Greetings.”’ Bond aims to redefine that experience — offering a deeply personal, human touch, delivered digitally from anywhere in the world. The system currently costs $199 (£130) to learn a user’s handwriting style. Each personalized card is priced at $2.99 (£1.90) and is available globally.

article_content: (CNN) — Civil rights groups filed a complaint this week against federal judge Edith Jones, alleging that during a February lecture to The Federalist Society at the University of Pennsylvania, she made racially charged statements suggesting that certain minority groups are predisposed to violence and crime. Jones, a judge on the 5th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals and a former contender for the U.S. Supreme Court under President George W. Bush, reportedly stated that race plays no role in the administration of the death penalty, but that certain ethnic groups commit specific types of crimes more frequently than others. The J.L. Turner Legal Association, an African American bar association based in Dallas, condemned the remarks as evidence of deep-seated ethnic bias. Its president, Mandy Price, said attendees expressed shock and offense at the comments. According to accounts collected by the association, Jones allegedly said, 'Racial groups like African Americans and Hispanics are predisposed to crime' and are 'prone to commit acts of violence.' She reportedly defended these claims by noting that Black and Hispanic individuals are overrepresented on death row. Price emphasized that judges must remain impartial and free from prejudicial assumptions. 'We expect them to be fair, not to enter the courtroom with predetermined views about race or criminality,' she said. The Federalist Society dismissed the allegations as 'frivolous accusations.' Meanwhile, the ACLU pointed out that Black Americans are arrested for marijuana possession at significantly higher rates than white Americans — a statistic sometimes cited to challenge claims about inherent criminality. Judge Jones has not publicly responded to the complaint. A spokesperson for the court, headquartered in New Orleans, confirmed she is not commenting on the matter. Legal analyst Tom Goldstein noted that Jones is best known for her opinion stating, 'While I’m a lower court judge, I will apply Roe v. Wade, but I think it was wrongly decided and should be overruled' — a stance reflecting her conservative jurisprudence and potential future rulings if elevated to the Supreme Court.
translated_content: (CNN) — 시민권 단체들은 이달 초 펜실베이니아 대학교에서 열린 연설에서 에디스 존스 판사가 특정 소수 집단이 폭력에 기울어져 있다고 주장했다며 공식 항의장을 제출했다. 존스 판사는 미국 제5순회항소법원 판사이며 조지 W. 부시 대통령 시절 대법원 후보로 거론된 인물로, 사형제 관련 연설 중 인종이 사형 집행에 영향을 미치지 않지만, 특정 민족 집단이 다른 집단보다 특정 범죄를 더 자주 저지른다고 말한 것으로 전해졌다. 댈러스에 기반을 둔 아프리카계 미국인 변호사 단체인 J.L. 터너 법조협회는 이 발언을 심각한 인종적 편견의 증거라며 강하게 비판했다. 협회의 회장 매디 프라이스는 청중이 이 발언에 충격과 불쾌감을 표현했다고 말했다. 협회가 수집한 증언에 따르면, 존스 판사는 '아프리카계 미국인과 히스패닉 계열과 같은 인종 집단은 범죄에 기울어져 있다'고 말했으며, '폭력 행위를 저지르기 쉬운 경향이 있다'고 덧붙였다. 그녀는 흑인과 히스패닉 계열이 사형 수용자에서 백인보다 더 많이 차지한다는 점을 들어 이 발언을 방어한 것으로 전해졌다. 프라이스는 재판관들이 공정하고 편견 없는 태도를 가져야 한다고 강조했다. 그녀는 '우리는 재판관들이 인종이나 범죄성에 대한 선입견을 안고 법정에 들어오지 않을 것이라고 기대한다'고 말했다. 연합회는 이 주장을 '무의미한 고발'이라며 일축했다. 한편, ACLU는 흑인 미국인들이 마리화나 소지로 체포되는 비율이 백인보다 훨씬 높다는 통계를 제시하며, 본질적인 범죄 성향에 대한 주장에 반박했다. 존스 판사는 현재까지 공개적으로 이 문제에 대해 언급하지 않았다. 뉴올리언스에 본부를 둔 법원 대변인은 그녀가 이 사안에 대해 발언하지 않겠다고 확인했다. 법률 전문가 톰 골드스타인은 존스 판사가 가장 유명한 판결 중 하나가 '저는 하급 법원 판사로서 로 대 웨이드 판례를 적용할 것이지만, 이 판례는 잘못된 결정이며 폐기되어야 한다고 생각한다'는 내용이었다며, 이는 그녀의 보수적 사법 철학을 반영하며 대법원 승진 시 미래 판결에 영향을 줄 수 있다고 설명했다.

article_content: Pammy Rose, a 22-year-old transgender woman from Seaham, County Durham, is preparing to audition for the next season of Big Brother — a dream fueled by her desire to share her story and inspire others. Assigned male at birth and named Paul Witten, Pammy has lived authentically as a woman since her teens, embracing her identity through fashion, makeup, and hormone therapy. She first gained public attention in 2013 when she reached the finals of 'The Face of Sunderland,' a local beauty contest. Organizers were unaware she was transgender until she revealed it during her interview — a moment she says was necessary to promote diversity and inclusion. Inspired by actress Pamela Anderson, Pammy adopted her current name at 18 and began hormone treatment at 19. Her mother supported her transition from age 16, helping her access medical care. She describes feeling trapped in a body that didn’t match her true self since childhood, enduring bullying and isolation until she embraced her identity. Now, Pammy hopes to become the second transgender winner of Big Brother, following Nadia. She recently received confirmation of her audition invitation and shared her excitement on social media: 'I’ve just received the email I’ve been waiting for! Looks like it’s the beginning of the audition process for Big Brother tomorrow!' Pammy says she is not afraid to be seen for who she truly is. 'I want to show the world this is who I am,' she said. 'I’m a woman — inside and out. And I’m ready to be heard.'

'세상에 내가 누구인지 보여주고 싶어요. 저는 안팎으로 여자예요. 그리고 이제 제 목소리를 듣길 원해요.'

article_content: During Chelsea’s 1-1 draw with Burnley at Stamford Bridge, midfielder Nemanja Matic was shown a red card for pushing Ashley Barnes after a dangerous tackle. While Matic’s reaction drew criticism, it paled in comparison to the shocking outburst by Worcester City’s Shabir Khan during their Conference North match against Stockport County. In the closing moments of the game, Khan responded to a reckless challenge by Stockport’s Charlie Russell by lifting the young midfielder and performing a dramatic, WWE-style body slam onto the pitch. The act prompted an immediate red card from the referee. Russell, meanwhile, received only a yellow card for the initial foul. Stockport County had already been reduced to 10 men after striker Jack Ryan was sent off for accumulating two bookable offenses. Despite playing with a numerical disadvantage, they still lost the match 2-0. Matic’s red card was for his retaliation, not the initial challenge — which many viewed as excessively aggressive. Barnes escaped punishment, though the tackle itself raised concerns about player safety.

article_content: In a video recorded near Damascus, Zahran Alloush, commander of the Syrian rebel group Jaysh al-Islam, delivered a passionate address to around 100 fighters, condemning ISIS as a corrupt force distorting the meaning of holy struggle. Standing in desert camouflage with a pistol at his side, Alloush’s serious demeanor was unexpectedly juxtaposed by a small pink Hello Kitty notepad resting on the table beside him — a detail that drew attention but did not detract from the gravity of his message. He labeled ISIS members as 'khawarij' — a classical Islamic term for those who break away from established religious and political order — accusing them of sabotaging jihadist efforts across multiple regions including Afghanistan, Chechnya, Bosnia, and Iraq. Now, he warned, they had turned their sights on Syria. Alloush cited the brutal murder of Abul Miqdam, whom ISIS allegedly executed by slitting his throat, as evidence of their cruelty. He also criticized the influx of foreign fighters within ISIS, calling them 'dirty b*******' with a toxic ideology that shows no respect for civilians. Meanwhile, according to the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights, 30 ISIS militants escaped from a detention facility run by rival Islamist groups in the village of al-Hawaaj. The group has since expanded its control in eastern Syria, seizing the villages of Quniya and Buqris from Nusra Front and consolidating territory near Mayadin. Analysts suggest ISIS now prioritizes fighting other rebel factions over the Syrian government, fueling internal chaos. Though often portrayed as a fringe extremist group, ISIS has grown into one of the most formidable armed networks in Syria, drawing thousands of foreign recruits from Europe and North Africa. Some reports claim it controls an area five times the size of Lebanon — though this figure lacks precise geographic verification.
translated_content: 다마스쿠스 근처에서 촬영된 영상에서, 자흐란 알루시는 시리아 반군 단체인 자이시 알-이슬람의 지휘관으로 약 100명의 전사들에게 강연을 펼치며 이슬람국가(ISIS)를 성스러운 투쟁의 의미를 왜곡하는 부패한 세력으로 비난했다. 사막 카모플라주 복장을 입고 총을 옆에 매달고 선 그의 진지한 태도는 책상 위에 놓인 작은 분홍색 헬로키티 노트와 대조를 이루었는데, 이 세부사항은 주목을 받았지만 그의 메시지의 무게를 줄이지는 않았다. 그는 ISIS 구성원들을 '하와리즈'라고 불렀다. 이는 전통적인 이슬람 용어로, 확립된 종교적·정치적 질서에서 벗어난 자들을 가리킨다. 그는 아프가니스탄, 체첸, 보스니아, 이라크 등 여러 지역에서 지하드 활동을 파괴했다고 비판하며, 이제 이들이 시리아를 겨냥하고 있다고 경고했다. 알루시는 ISIS가 압살 미카담을 목을 베어 살해했다고 말하며, 이들의 잔혹성을 증거로 제시했다. 또한 ISIS 내 외국인 전사들의 유입을 비판하며, 그들을 '더럽고도 악랄한 자들'이라고 부르며 시민들을 전혀 존중하지 않는 악독한 이데올로기를 가졌다고 주장했다. 한편, 시리아 인권 관측소에 따르면, 30명의 ISIS 전투원이 다른 이슬람주의 단체가 운영하던 감옥에서 탈출했다. 이들은 알하와지 마을에서 탈출한 후 동부 시리아에서 영토를 확장했으며, 누스라 전선으로부터 쿠니야와 부크리스 마을을 점령하고 메이다딘 근처에 기반을 마련했다. 전문가들은 ISIS가 시리아 정부보다 다른 반군 세력과의 충돌에 더 많은 시간을 할애하고 있어 내부 혼란을 가속화하고 있다고 분석했다. 종종 극단적 소수 집단으로 묘사되곤 하지만, ISIS는 유럽과 북아프리카에서 수천 명의 외국인 지원자를 모집하며 시리아에서 가장 강력한 무장 네트워크 중 하나로 성장했다. 일부 보고서에서는 ISIS가 레바논 면적의 다섯 배에 달하는 영역을 통제한다고 주장하지만, 이 수치는 정확한 지리적 검증이 아직 이루어지지 않았다.

article_content: Beirut, Lebanon (CNN) — Search teams have located the flight data recorder from an Ethiopian Airlines Boeing 737-800 that crashed Monday, killing all 90 people on board, the Lebanese army announced Thursday. The black box, which contains critical flight information, was detected at a depth of approximately 1,300 meters in the Mediterranean Sea—but has not yet been recovered. The plane, en route to Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, went down just minutes after takeoff from Beirut, crashing about 3.5 kilometers (2 miles) west of the coastal town of Na'ameh, roughly 15 kilometers (9 miles) south of the capital. So far, at least 14 bodies have been recovered from the wreckage. Ethiopian Airlines, one of Africa’s largest carriers, operates flights across Europe, Asia, North America, and beyond. CNN’s Nada Husseini contributed to this report.
translated_content: 베이루트, 레바논(CNN) — 수색팀은 월요일 사고로 탑승객 90명 전원이 사망한 에티오피아 항공 보잉 737-800의 비행 데이터 기록장치를 발견했다고 레바논 군이 목요일 발표했다. 이 블랙박스는 비행 정보를 저장하는 장치로, 지중해 약 1,300미터 깊이에서 확인되었으나 아직 인양되지 않았다. 이 항공기는 에티오피아 아디스아바바로 향하던 중 베이루트 이륙 직후 추락했으며, 베이루트 남쪽 약 15km 떨어진 해안 마을 나아메 서쪽 약 3.5km(2마일) 지점에 추락했다. 지금까지 최소 14구의 시신이 수습됐다. 에티오피아 항공은 아프리카 최대 항공사 중 하나로 유럽, 아시아, 북아메리카 등을 포함한 다수의 대륙을 연결한다. CNN의 나다 후세니가 이 보도에 기여했다.

article_content: Unveiled in Zhuhai, China, the Adastra is a £15 million superyacht that blends cutting-edge technology with elegant design. Commissioned by Hong Kong shipping magnate Anto Marden after five years of development, this trimaran isn’t just a vessel—it’s a statement of modern luxury. Designed by British yacht architect John Shuttleworth, the Adastra pushes boundaries with a lightweight glass-and-Kevlar hull, capable of carrying nine guests and a crew of five to six across vast oceans without refueling. Its standout feature? Remote operation via iPad—though you must stay within 50 meters to use it. With a top speed of 22.5 knots and a range of 4,000 nautical miles at cruising speed, it’s engineered for long-distance comfort, not just spectacle. The main deck offers panoramic views, a spacious saloon, and a rear deck that transforms into a swim platform. Powered by a single Caterpillar C18 engine (1,150 hp) and two Yanmar 110 hp outriggers, the Adastra prioritizes efficiency over extravagance, making it a contender for the future of sustainable superyachting. While billionaire Roman Abramovich’s Eclipse boasts submarines and laser anti-paparazzi shields, Adastra quietly redefines luxury through innovation rather than excess.

article_content: At 101 years old, Herman 'Hy' Goldman shows no signs of slowing down — even after seven decades at the same job. Every Monday through Thursday, he arrives at Capitol Lighting in East Hanover, New Jersey, where he’s been working since 1941, save for a few years spent serving in the U.S. Army during World War II. What started as stocking shelves and cleaning displays evolved into managing the store, and today, Goldman finds his greatest joy in his workshop, painstakingly restoring broken and discarded light fixtures. 'It’s not just a job,' he told News 12 New Jersey. 'It’s why I wake up every day.' His coworkers threw him a heartfelt celebration for his birthday, honoring a man they describe as both a master craftsman and a quiet inspiration. Colleague Sandy Ronco notes that each repaired fixture is a puzzle with its own story — and each one teaches him something new. Goldman, who still drives himself to work in his 1999 Ford Contour, lives nearby in Whippany. He credits his enduring spirit not only to work but to the memory of his late wife, a kind woman who once worked alongside him. 'She was wonderful,' says co-owner Max Lebersfeld. 'He came back from losing her — and kept going.' Even at 96, he told ABC News he felt great — standing tall, feeling alive. Now, at 101, he’s still here, still fixing lights, still living fully.
translated_content: 101세의 허먼 '하이' 골드먼은 같은 일자리에서 일한 지 70년이 넘었음에도 불구하고 느긋해질 기미가 전혀 없다. 그는 매주 월요일부터 목요일까지 뉴저지 이스트하노버에 위치한 캐피톨 라이팅에 출근한다. 그는 1941년부터 근무해 왔으며, 단지 제2차 세계대전 당시 미군으로 복무했던 몇 년을 제외하면 말이다. 처음에는 상품 진열과 청소를 맡았던 일이 점차 매장 관리로 발전했고, 지금은 고장 나거나 버려진 조명기를 정성스럽게 수리하는 작업실에서 가장 큰 즐거움을 찾는다. 그는 뉴저지 뉴스12와의 인터뷰에서 이렇게 말했다. '단순한 직업이 아니야. 매일 아침 일어나는 이유야.' 동료들은 그의 생일을 맞아 따뜻한 축하 행사를 열었고, 그를 숙련된 장인이고 침묵의 영감으로 묘사했다. 동료 샌디 론코는 매번 수리하는 조명기가 독특한 퍼즐처럼 각기 다른 이야기를 담고 있으며, 그때마다 새로운 것을 배운다고 말한다. 골드먼은 여전히 1999년식 포드 컨투어를 운전해 근처 휘판에 살며 출퇴근한다. 그는 끊임없는 활력의 원천을 단순히 일뿐만 아니라, 함께 일했던 고인 아내의 기억에도 돌린다. '그녀는 멋진 사람이었어요.' 코오너 매ックス 레버스펠트가 말했다. '그녀를 잃은 후에도 그는 다시 일어났고, 계속 앞으로 나아갔죠.' 96세 때 그는 ABC 뉴스와의 인터뷰에서 '정말 기분이 좋아요. 허리를 똑바로 세우고 있어요.'라고 말했고, 이제 101세가 된 그는 여전히 조명기를 수리하며, 살아가고 있다.

article_content: Washington (CNN) — President Obama announced a plan to nearly double the Child and Dependent Care Tax Credit for middle-class families, marking the latest effort by his administration to bolster confidence among Americans concerned about the sluggish economic recovery. The proposal is one of five new initiatives from the President’s Middle Class Task Force, formed one year ago this week. It arrives as the White House, adopting a more populist tone, seeks to win back independent voters who have recently shifted toward the GOP following electoral losses in Massachusetts, New Jersey, and Virginia. 'The middle class has been under sustained pressure for years,' Obama said in remarks near the White House. 'None of these steps alone will solve every challenge facing American families — but together, they can help restore some of the financial stability that’s been lost.' Under the plan, the tax credit rate would rise from 20% to 35% for households earning under $85,000 annually. Families earning between $85,000 and $115,000 would also benefit from an increased credit. Additionally, low-income families would receive a $1.6 billion boost in child care funding — the largest single-year increase in two decades. Other proposals include capping federal student loan repayments at 10% of a borrower’s income above a basic living allowance; establishing automatic workplace IRAs that require employers to offer direct-deposit retirement accounts; and expanding the Saver’s Tax Credit to provide a 50% government match on the first $1,000 saved annually by families earning $65,000 or less. The administration also plans to strengthen retirement savings protections and expand federal assistance for families caring for elderly relatives — aiming to help caregivers balance work and family duties while enabling seniors to remain in their communities longer. Since its launch, the Middle Class Task Force has held 11 meetings nationwide and at the White House. All five proposals will be included in Obama’s Fiscal Year 2011 budget, scheduled for release on February 1. The president is also expected to highlight middle-class economic priorities in his upcoming State of the Union address. CNN’s Suzanne Malveaux contributed to this report.
translated_content: 워싱턴(CNN) — 오바마 대통령은 중산층 가정을 위한 아동 보육 세액 공제를 거의 두 배로 늘리는 계획을 발표했다. 이는 경제 회복이 더디다는 우려 속에서 미국인들의 신뢰를 높이기 위한 행정부의 최근 조치이다. 이 제안은 일년 전 이 시기에 설립된 대통령의 중산층 태스크포스에서 제시한 다섯 가지 새로운 이니셔티브 중 하나이다. 최근 매사추세츠, 뉴저지, 버지니아에서의 선거에서 공화당으로 표가 몰리면서 백악관은 점점 더 포퓰리스트적인 어조로 전환하며 독립 유권자들을 되찾으려 하고 있다. 오바마 대통령은 백악관 근처에서 연설하며 '중산층은 수년간 지속적인 압박을 받아왔다. 이 조치들만으로 모든 도전을 해결할 수는 없지만, 함께하면 최근 잃어버린 재정적 안정을 일부 회복할 수 있을 것이다.'라고 말했다. 이 계획에 따라, 연소득 8만5천 달러 미만 가구의 세액 공제율은 20%에서 35%로 상향된다. 8만5천 달러에서 11만5천 달러 사이의 가구 역시 세액 공제 혜택이 증가한다. 또한 저소득 가정에는 20년 만에 가장 큰 규모인 16억 달러의 아동 보육 자금이 추가 지원된다. 다른 제안으로는 학생 대출 상환액을 기본 생활비를 초과하는 소득의 10%로 제한하고, 고용주가 직원에게 직접 입금형 IRA 계좌 가입 기회를 제공하도록 하는 자동 직장 IRA 도입, 그리고 연소득 6만5천 달러 이하 가정에 대해 최초 1,000달러 저축에 대해 정부가 50%를 매칭해주는 세액 공제 확대가 포함된다. 행정부는 또한 은퇴 저축 보호 장치를 강화하고, 노인을 돌보는 가족을 위한 연방 지원을 확대할 계획이다. 이는 부양 책임을 분담하고 노인들이 지역사회에서 오래도록 생활할 수 있도록 돕는 것을 목표로 한다. 태스크포스는 설립 이후 전국 및 백악관에서 총 11회의 회의를 개최했다. 이 다섯 가지 제안은 모두 2월 1일 발표될 예정인 오바마 행정부의 2011 회계연도 예산안에 포함될 예정이다. 대통령은 또한 예정된 국정연설에서 중산층 경제 문제를 강조할 것으로 예상된다. CNN의 수잔 마벨로가 이 보고서에 기여했다.

article_content: WASHINGTON (CNN) — President Obama marked Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, and Transgender Pride Month with a White House reception on Monday, drawing a powerful parallel between the fight for LGBTQ+ rights and the historic struggle for African-American civil rights. Surrounded by cheering supporters in the East Room and joined by First Lady Michelle Obama, President Obama announced his administration’s commitment to repealing the Defense of Marriage Act (DOMA) and ending the military’s 'don't ask, don't tell' policy. 'I know many in this room feel progress has come too slowly — and I understand,' Obama said. 'It’s not my place to ask you to be patient, any more than it was right for others to urge patience on those demanding equality half a century ago.' The 'don't ask, don't tell' policy prohibited service members from disclosing their sexual orientation while also barring commanders from inquiring about it — leading to discharges if orientation was discovered. Obama called the policy a threat to national security, stating, 'Preventing patriotic Americans from serving weakens us all.' Repealing DOMA and ending the military ban required congressional action and would take time, he acknowledged. DOMA denied federal recognition to same-sex marriages, even in states where they were legal, making it a deeply divisive issue, especially among conservative and religious groups. Obama emphasized that while the government must uphold current laws, it must also strive to heal divisions rather than deepen them. 'Upholding the law does not diminish my resolve to change it,' he declared. He also urged Congress to pass legislation ensuring full healthcare and spousal benefits for LGBTQ+ couples and their children, strengthening hate crime protections, and banning employment discrimination based on sexual orientation or gender identity. 'There are unjust laws to overturn and unfair practices to end,' Obama said. 'And yes — some of your neighbors, maybe even your own family, still cling to outdated beliefs and refuse to see your love as equal to theirs. That hurts. And I know how deeply that cuts.' Reflecting on the 40th anniversary of the Stonewall Riots — when patrons of a New York gay bar resisted a police raid, igniting a multi-day protest — Obama remarked, 'History shows us that when courage takes root, nothing can stop it.' He paused, then added with a smile: 'Truthfully, when people stood up at Stonewall 40 years ago, no one could have imagined that either you — or I — would be standing here today.' The crowd erupted in cheers, then laughter.
translated_content: 워싱턴(CNN) — 오바마 대통령은 월요일 백악관에서 열린 행사에서 동성애자, 양성애자, 성전환자(PRIDE)의 달을 기념하며 아프리카계 미국인의 시민권 운동과 LGBTQ+ 권리 투쟁 사이에 강력한 유사점을 제시했다. 미셸 오바마 대통령 부인과 함께 환영받는 군중들 사이에서 오바마 대통령은 결혼 보호법(DOMA) 폐지와 군대 내 '묻지 마라, 말하지 마라' 정책 종료를 행정부가 추진할 것이라고 발표했다. '이 자리에 계신 많은 분들이 진전이 너무 느리다고 느끼고 계신다는 걸 알고 있고, 그 마음을 진심으로 이해합니다. 반세기 전 시민권을 요구하던 아프리카계 미국인들에게 인내를 요청했던 사람들처럼, 저도 여러분에게 인내를 요청할 수 없습니다.' '묻지 마라, 말하지 마라' 정책은 병사가 자신의 성적 지향을 공개하는 것을 금지하면서도, 지휘관이 이를 묻는 것도 금지했고, 성적 지향이 드러나면 해고를 초래했습니다. 오바마 대통령은 이 정책이 국가 안보에 위협이 된다며, '애국적인 미국인들이 국가를 위해 봉사하는 것을 막는 것은 우리를 약화시킵니다.'라고 말했습니다. DOMA 폐지와 군대 정책 종료는 의회의 행동이 필요하며 시간이 걸릴 것이라고 그는 인정했습니다. DOMA는 주 단위로 합법화된 동성 결혼조차 연방 정부가 인정하지 못하게 했으며, 이는 특히 보수층과 종교 우익 사이에서 심각한 분열을 일으킨 문제였습니다. 오바마 대통령은 정부가 현재 법률을 존중해야 한다고 강조하면서도, 갈등을 심화시키기보다는 치유에 힘써야 한다고 말했습니다. '법을 지키는 것이 법을 바꾸려는 제 의지를 줄이는 것이 아니라는 점을 분명히 합니다.' 그는 또한 LGBTQ+ 커플과 그 자녀들에게 건강보험 및 배우자 혜택을 보장하고, 인종 혐오 범죄 처벌을 강화하며, 성적 지향 또는 성 정체성을 이유로 한 고용 차별을 금지하는 법안 통과를 촉구했습니다. '바꿔야 할 부당한 법률과 멈춰야 할 불공정한 관행이 있습니다.' 오바마는 말했습니다. '그리고 여러분의 이웃, 혹은 심지어 가족 중 일부는 여전히 낡은 사고방식을 고수하며, 당신의 사랑을 그들의 사랑과 같게 여기지 않고, 대부분의 미국인이 당연하게 여기는 권리를 빼앗으려 합니다. 그건 아픕니다. 그리고 얼마나 깊이 상처를 주는지 저는 잘 알고 있습니다.' 뉴욕의 게이 바에서 경찰의 습격에 항의하며 며칠간 이어진 스톤월 폭동의 40주년을 회상하며 오바마 대통령은 말했습니다. '역사는 용기가 뿌리를 내리면 아무것도 그것을 막을 수 없다는 것을 보여줍니다.' 그는 잠시 멈춘 후 미소를 지으며 덧붙였습니다. '정말로, 40년 전 스톤월에서 사람들이 일어났을 때, 여러분이나 제가 오늘 이 자리에 서 있을 거라고는 아무도 상상하지 못했을 겁니다.' 청중은 박수로 환호하며 웃음으로 응답했습니다.

article_content: A minuscule gecko, so small it fits on the tip of a pencil, has captured hearts at Houston Zoo. Known as the Fantastic or Satanic leaf-tailed gecko, this creature boasts raised brow ridges and an uncanny ability to blend into its surroundings—mimicking fallen leaves with astonishing precision, complete with fake veins and jagged edges. Its legs resemble twigs, making it nearly invisible among foliage. Born last month in Texas, this tiny reptile is still growing but already shows the remarkable traits of its species. Staff often struggle to locate it in its enclosure—even when staring directly at it. The gecko’s scientific name, Uroplatus phantasticus, means 'imaginary flat tail,' a fitting label given its otherworldly look. First described in 1888 by British zoologist George Albert Boulenger, it was dubbed 'mythical' for its bizarre, almost surreal appearance. Native to Madagascar, where deforestation, farming, and livestock grazing threaten its survival, this nocturnal hunter feeds on crickets and moths. Unlike most lizards, it lacks eyelids and cleans its eyes with its long, flexible tongue. When scared, it flattens its body to vanish against surfaces, reveals a startling red mouth, or even drops its tail to escape predators. Females lay two eggs at a time, and adults eventually reach 4 to 6 inches in length—though right now, our little star is about the size of a pencil eraser.

article_content: A surprising finding from a 2012 study of Tour de France cyclists suggests that riders perceived as more attractive tended to perform better — not because of looks alone, but possibly because facial features may unconsciously signal physical endurance. Researchers from the University of Zurich showed photos of cyclists to volunteers who had no knowledge of their race results. Participants rated faces based solely on appearance. These ratings were then matched against actual race outcomes, including individual time trials — a measure less influenced by team dynamics. The results, published in Biology Letters, revealed a clear pattern: those deemed more attractive also completed stages faster. The team theorizes that, evolutionarily, humans may have developed a subconscious ability to read facial cues as indicators of stamina — traits once vital for survival, like enduring long hunts across African savannas. Amaël Moinard, a French rider, topped the attractiveness list, while reigning world champion Rui Costa ranked high in both looks and performance. Notably, the top three British riders — Bradley Wiggins, Mark Cavendish, and Chris Froome — were left out of the analysis because their official team photos showed them wearing caps or sunglasses, obscuring their faces. Erik Postma, lead researcher, commented wryly: 'Wiggins could prove the rule — or break it. Maybe you don’t need to be handsome to win. That’s encouraging news for the rest of us.'

article_content: The living descendants of King Richard III are urging that his remains be reburied in York, not Leicester, where his skeleton was discovered in a council car park in 2012. Identified earlier this month, the 500-year-old remains belong to the last Plantagenet king, who spent much of his life in Yorkshire and ruled England for just 26 months. A petition demanding his reinterment in York has gathered over 23,000 signatures. Nine of his direct descendants — including 16th- and 17th-generation great-nieces and great-nephews — issued a formal statement declaring Richard III the last king of the House of York and asserting that his true spiritual home lies in York. They wrote: 'We do hereby most respectfully demand that the remains of King Richard III, our mutual ancestor, be returned to the city of York for formal, ceremonial reburial. We believe that such an interment was his desire in life.' Richard III, known as Richard of York before becoming king, grew up at Middleham Castle, visited York frequently, and even contributed to funding its medieval city walls. Today, York honors him with a museum, a hotel named after him, and even a locally produced Wensleydale cheese bearing his name. Despite these strong regional ties, Leicester Cathedral has been designated as his final resting place, following the University of Leicester’s excavation and legal permissions. The UK Ministry of Justice has stated that the exhumation decision rested solely with the university. City officials in York have appealed to the Queen and the Ministry of Justice, asking for the remains to be transferred to what they call his 'spiritual home.'

article_content: After last seeing Captain Jack Sparrow on a sunlit beach with his loyal first mate Gibbs, the pirate mused wistfully about whether he might still achieve immortality—even without drinking from the Fountain of Youth. 'Who’s to say I won’t live forever anyway?' he quipped, capturing his trademark charm. Though the fifth Pirates of the Caribbean film has faced setbacks—including delays and the costly flop of Disney’s The Lone Ranger—it’s now confirmed: the movie hits theaters on July 7, 2017. Even though 2011’s On Stranger Tides received mixed reviews, it raked in over $1 billion globally, making another installment financially inevitable. Originally slated for a 2015 debut under the working title Dead Men Tell No Tales, the project shifted directors from Rob Marshall to Joachim Ronning and Espen Sandberg, known for their work on Kon-Tiki. Production stalled last summer amid budget constraints and an incomplete script, but Disney has since rebooted its plans. With Jack back on course, fans can once again brace for swashbuckling chaos.

article_content: By Steph Cockroft Hollywood Smile: The Duchess of Cambridge opted for orthodontic 'micro-rotations' to achieve a more uniform smile. The old saying goes that you're never fully dressed without a smile—but today, it’s less about the smile itself and more about the teeth beneath it. According to prominent author Malcolm Gladwell, best known for 'David and Goliath,' dental health is emerging as a new marker of social inequality. Gladwell told The Times: 'That’s kind of the way we’re moving as the gap between the fit and the unfit grows. The teeth thing and the obesity problem are symptoms of the same set of inferences being drawn. I think these physical characteristics are the next wave of discrimination.' This perspective follows a growing trend among celebrities and reality TV stars who invest in cosmetic dental procedures—including teeth whitening, veneers, and titanium dental implants. Experts warn that while affluent individuals can afford transformative dental work, those from lower-income backgrounds often cannot access even basic care. Data from the UK’s Health and Social Care Information Centre supports this divide: in 2011, one-fifth of hospital dental admissions came from the most deprived 10% of England’s population. Statistics also reveal that patients aged 0–29 received three times more dental treatments than those over 60—contrary to traditional assumptions that older adults have worse dental health. A 2022 VisionCritical poll found that people perceive individuals with whiter teeth as earning £10,000 more annually than they actually do, appearing up to five years younger, and having 10% higher employment potential. Eddie Crouch of the British Dental Association noted a stark disparity: many teenagers from socially deprived areas are referred for orthodontic care but cannot receive it due to severe underlying dental health issues.

article_content: A family was left horrified after discovering a four-inch razor blade embedded in a loaf of bread purchased from Morrisons’ in-store bakery. Andy Newman, 37, of Motspur Park in southwest London, bought the sliced loaf for a Mother’s Day lunch last Sunday. As his wife, Pippa, reached into the bag to serve a slice to their three-year-old daughter, Madison, she noticed the blade protruding from the bread—just in time to prevent disaster. The blade, described as sharp and serrated, was likely a fragment that broke off from one of the automated slicing machines used to cut the bread in-store. Mr. Newman immediately returned to the Morrisons store on Wimbledon Broadway to file a complaint. He was shocked when the manager initially offered only a £1.30 refund—the exact price of the loaf. After further insistence, the manager reluctantly provided £30 in store vouchers—but Mr. Newman said the response felt half-hearted. 'I would have been on my knees saying, 'Oh my god, I can’t believe that was in your bread,' he said. 'This wasn’t just a faulty product—it was a life-threatening hazard.' Morrisons later issued a formal apology, stating they take food safety extremely seriously. They confirmed they had inspected remaining stock and believed the incident was an isolated event. The company’s technical team is now investigating how the blade fragment entered the product. The store manager also said she had apologized profusely and escalated the matter to customer services.

article_content: In a tragic development, human remains were discovered in Riverside, California, during an intensive search for 22-year-old Brittany Killgore, who vanished after filing for divorce from her husband, Marine Lance Corporal Cory Killgore. Though officials have not yet confirmed the identity of the body, they say the circumstances strongly suggest foul play. Cory, currently serving in Afghanistan, is returning home on emergency leave as authorities investigate. Brittany was last seen on Friday night in Fallbrook, where she lived, and her cellphone was later found in San Diego’s Gaslamp District — though police believe she never reached her intended destination. A key figure in the case is Louis Ray Perez, a 45-year-old fellow Marine based at Camp Pendleton, who was arrested on Sunday for allegedly possessing a stolen AR-15 rifle taken from the base. While Perez has not been formally charged in connection with Brittany’s disappearance, investigators say he was uncooperative during questioning and that his actions, combined with Brittany’s abrupt silence after days of regular communication, point to a possible crime. San Diego County Sheriff’s officials emphasized that Cory Killgore is not a suspect and is being treated as a grieving family member. Brittany, described as 5-foot-7, 130 pounds, with brown hair and eyes, was last seen wearing a dark purple gown adorned with floral glitter patterns. Search teams combed canyons near Fallbrook and her apartment, but no other evidence has surfaced. The case remains active, with law enforcement urging anyone with information to come forward.

article_content: By Mail on Sunday Reporter. The Skye terrier, one of Britain’s most endangered dog breeds — rarer than the wild panda — is experiencing a modest revival thanks to a surge in breeding. In the first three months of this year, 11 Skye terrier puppies were registered with the Kennel Club, compared to just one during the same period last year. However, global population estimates remain critically low, with fewer than 3,000 Skye terriers worldwide and fewer than 400 in Britain. Experts say at least 300 Skye terrier puppies must be born annually to prevent extinction. For context, the global wild panda population stands at approximately 4,000. The breed’s renewed popularity is largely attributed to Lampard, a prick-eared Skye terrier who reached the Best in Show final at Crufts last year. His owner, Sue Breeze of Swadlincote, Derbyshire, said, 'The latest figures from the Kennel Club show we’re succeeding in making the breed more popular.' She hopes more people will consider adopting one. 'A puppy costs around £650 — when you consider many pay over £1,000 for designer breeds, Skye terriers are reasonably priced,' she added. The Skye terrier is one of the UK’s oldest native breeds, dating back to the 14th century. It is widely believed the breed originated from local terriers mating with dogs that survived the sinking of a Spanish Armada warship. Iconic figures associated with the breed include Greyfriars Bobby, the 19th-century Edinburgh dog famed for guarding his master’s grave for 14 years, and Mary Queen of Scots, who is said to have concealed a Skye terrier beneath her skirt during her execution. The breed is also thought to have inspired Dougal, the beloved dog character from the children’s TV series The Magic Roundabout. The Kennel Club is encouraged by the uptick in registrations and hopes it will spark renewed interest in other endangered native breeds, including the Cardigan Welsh corgi, the Dandie Dinmont terrier, and the English setter — the latter of which has fewer than 300 registered individuals in Britain. A Kennel Club spokesperson noted, 'While this is positive news for a vulnerable breed, we’ve observed growing popularity in foreign and celebrity-endorsed small handbag dogs.'

'강아지 가격은 약 650파운드인데, 많은 사람들이 디자이너 강아지에 1,000파운드 이상을 지불하는 것을 생각하면 스카이 테리어는 합리적인 가격이다'라고 그녀는 말했다. 스카이 테리어는 14세기까지 거슬러 올라가는 영국 최고의 고유 품종 중 하나이다. 이 품종은 지역 테리어와 스페인 무적함대의 침몰선에서 생존한 개들이 교배되어 탄생했다고 널리 알려져 있다. 이 품종과 관련된 유명한 인물로는 19세기 에딘버러의 개 그레이프리어스 보비가 있는데, 그는 경찰관 주인 존 그레이의 무덤을 14년간 지켰다고 유명하다. 또한 메리 여왕은 처형 당할 때 스카이 테리어를 치마 아래 숨겼다는 전설이 있다. 이 품종은 어린이 TV 시리즈 '마법의 원'의 사랑받는 개 캐릭터 두갈의 모티브가 되었을 것으로 추정된다. 켄넬 클럽은 등록 수의 증가에 기뻐하며, 이 트렌드가 카디건 웨일스 코기, 댄디 딘먼트 테리어, 그리고 영국 내 등록된 개체수가 300마리 미만인 잉글리시 세터 같은 다른 멸종 위기 품종에도 관심을 불러일으키길 기대하고 있다. 켄넬 클럽 대변인은 '이것은 취약한 품종에 대한 긍정적인 소식이지만, 외국 품종과 유명인들에 의해 인기 있는 소형 핸드백 강아지들의 인기가 점점 높아지고 있다는 점도 눈여겨보고 있다'고 말했다.

article_content: This week, it was revealed that some UK schools have been provided with educational resources from Brook, a sexual health charity, suggesting that sexual behaviors—including kissing and consensual oral or penetrative sex—are 'normal' for children as young as 13. The so-called 'traffic light tool' categorizes such acts as 'green'—indicating developmentally appropriate behavior—for children aged 13 to 15, based on factors like mutual consent and emotional understanding. In response, a woman who lost her virginity at age 13 shared her story, describing it as one of the most damaging experiences of her life. She recalled being in a three-year on-and-off relationship with an 18-year-old boyfriend whom she idolized for picking her up from school on his motorbike. At the time, she believed it was 'first love,' but later recognized it as intense infatuation. Although she was on contraception and the encounters were consensual, she suffered severe emotional distress during and after the relationship, including depression, obsessive thoughts, and low self-esteem. Now an adult with a 15-year-old niece, she is alarmed by the idea that children might be taught such behavior is normal. She believes emotional maturity—not just biological readiness—is critical. She wishes her mother had discussed the emotional risks, not just the physical ones, and regrets how early sexual activity distorted her view of relationships and self-worth. She urges educators to focus on emotional development, mental health, and the long-term psychological consequences of early sexual activity—not just disease prevention or consent mechanics. While the age of consent varies globally—from 13 to 20—the UK sets it at 16, reinforcing that adolescents under this age are legally considered unable to give full informed consent.

article_content: London (CNN) — Following a renewed effort to uncover leads in the case of missing British girl Madeleine McCann, UK authorities are seeking assistance from Portuguese officials. On Friday, the Crown Prosecution Service sent a letter to Portuguese authorities requesting permission to conduct interviews related to the girl’s 2007 disappearance from her family’s holiday villa in the resort town of Praia da Luz. Pedro do Carmo, deputy national director of Portugal’s Judiciary Police, said Portuguese authorities had not yet received the letter. However, he confirmed that the latest phase of the Scotland Yard investigation centers on three individuals. Do Carmo declined to disclose their nationalities, noting none have been detained. This development comes roughly three months after new police sketches of potential suspects were released and UK police aired a televised appeal for information. That campaign triggered a flood of tips, prompting Portuguese authorities to reopen the case that same month. Madeleine was three years old when she vanished in June 2007 while on vacation with her family. Her disappearance sparked global headlines. Since October, investigations by UK and Portuguese police have proceeded in parallel. Do Carmo stated that Portuguese detectives have maintained constant communication with their British counterparts. Investigators are also examining a surge in break-ins in the area during the weeks leading up to Madeleine’s disappearance — including two incidents in the same building complex where her family was staying.

article_content: Hours after condemning a campaign to make 'Ding Dong! The Witch Is Dead' the UK's number-one song, the BBC reversed course and announced it would play a brief excerpt during its Radio 1 chart show — sparking accusations of hypocrisy and political capitulation. The move came less than a week after the death of Baroness Margaret Thatcher, Britain’s longest-serving peacetime prime minister, and reignited fierce debate over respect, free speech, and media responsibility. The song, a 51-second tune from The Wizard of Oz, surged in popularity thanks to a coordinated online effort, climbing to No. 3 on the UK Official Charts and topping the iTunes chart. It needed only 5,000 more sales to reach No. 2. Conservative figures, including Tory MPs and allies of Thatcher, denounced the decision as deeply offensive. They argued the campaign was orchestrated by far-left activists seeking to mock a revered leader who survived the 1984 Brighton bombing. BBC Director General Lord Tony Hall defended the choice, stating that while he found the campaign distasteful, banning the song would violate free speech and inadvertently amplify its reach. Radio 1 controller Ben Cooper, who publicly stated he made the decision, echoed this, emphasizing that ignoring a chart phenomenon would misrepresent public sentiment. Despite the BBC's claim that only a snippet would be played — and that lyrics containing the phrase 'the witch is dead' might be edited — many critics remained unconvinced. Some, like former defence minister Sir Gerald Howarth, questioned whether the BBC still upheld standards of taste and decency. Notably, Radio 2 had already aired a 15-second clip during a debate on the Jeremy Vine Show, framing it as context for discussion. Meanwhile, former Radio 1 DJ Mike Read offered a rare counterpoint, suggesting Thatcher herself would have dismissed the outrage as beneath her. The controversy echoed the 2009 'Killing in the Name' campaign, where a Facebook-led movement successfully blocked the X Factor winner from claiming the Christmas No. 1. Critics warned this incident could normalize politicized chart manipulation.

'딩동! 마녀는 죽었다'는 51초 분량의 1939년 영화 《오즈의 마법사》의 노래로, 온라인 캠페인의 힘으로 UK 공식 차트 3위, iTunes 차트 1위에 올랐다. 2위 진입에는 단지 5,000장만 더 판매하면 됐다. 보수 진영 인사들과 대처 여사의 지지자들은 이 결정을 심각하게 불경스럽다고 비난하며, 이 캠페인이 1984년 브라이튼 폭탄 테러 생존자인 존경받는 지도자를 조롱하려는 극좌 활동가들의 계획이라고 주장했다. BBC 최고책임자 토니 홀 경은 캠페인을 부적절하다고 느끼지만, 이 곡을 금지하면 표현의 자유를 침해하고 오히려 더 큰 주목을 받게 될 것이라며 결정을 옹호했다. Radio 1 컨트롤러 벤 쿠퍼는 이 결정을 자신이 내렸다고 공개적으로 밝히며, 대중의 음악 구매 행태를 무시하는 것이 여론을 왜곡할 수 있다고 말했다. article_content: Nicola and Paul Walling wanted more room for their family when they began building an extension on their home in Fareham, Hampshire. What they found instead was an unexpected link to the past — the partial remains of French soldiers captured during the Napoleonic Wars. Buried beneath their garden, archaeologists identified bones belonging to two or three sturdy men, estimated to be nearly 300 years old. Among the finds was a jawbone with three intact teeth. The discovery came after their builder, initially thinking the bones were animal remains, unearthed a larger bone and alerted authorities. Police arrived, then handed the case over to experts at Southampton University. The Wallings’ home sits just 100 yards from the site of a former prisoner-of-war hospital and close to Portchester Castle, where thousands of French captives were held during Britain’s conflict with Napoleon. Similar burials were uncovered in the area three decades ago. Though the exact cause of death remains unknown, many prisoners perished from disease while held in overcrowded conditions, including on decommissioned navy ships in Portsmouth Harbour. Initially startled, even imagining a crime scene from their favorite show, Silent Witness, the couple eventually agreed to let archaeologists rebury the remains in their garden. Now, they say, they’ve come to see the discovery not as a disturbance, but as a quiet connection to history — one that makes their home feel a little more meaningful.

article_content: Alan Whicker, the celebrated British journalist and documentary maker known for his sharp, witty explorations of eccentric elites, quietly lived a deeply private life — especially in his final years. Though he charmed audiences with tales of Hollywood’s obsession with youth, he himself concealed a simple truth: he was older than he let on. Public records, including his Who’s Who entry and the BBC’s obituary, listed his birth year as 1925, making him 87 at his death in 2013. In reality, Whicker was born on August 2, 1921, meaning he was 91. He never corrected the record, even as his health declined and he retreated to his home in Jersey with Valerie Kleeman, his partner of 44 years. She was 24 years his junior, and though Whicker once joked about preferring blondes, brunettes, and redheads, his real devotion was to Valerie, who photographed his books and produced his later films. His age deception wasn’t malicious — more a quiet quirk, perhaps a nod to an industry obsessed with appearances. Similar stories abound: Joan Collins omitted her true birth year after turning 80, and chef Antony Worrall Thompson, despite intensive therapy, still couldn’t explain why he stole groceries. Meanwhile, Atty Gordon-Lennox, daughter of Lord March, stunned guests at the Goodwood Festival of Speed with a dramatic half-shaved hairstyle — a spontaneous act of self-expression she called ‘just for fun.’ Her father, though sweet, admitted he’d prefer her looking more traditionally feminine. In another twist, Formula 1 legend Damon Hill didn’t push his son Josh to follow in his racing footsteps; instead, he supported Josh’s decision to become a rock drummer. ‘Children aren’t horses,’ Hill said. ‘They need to love what they do.’ Elsewhere, hair stylist Lee Stafford traveled to New York with his new wife, Jessica-Jane Clement, a reality TV star aiming to become an actress — leaving Sir Mick Jagger temporarily without his usual trim. And in a bizarre twist of irony, showbiz agent Jonathan Shalit gained 1.5kg during a stay at a luxury Austrian weight-loss retreat, joking he was ‘£10,000 lighter’ — referring to his bank account, not his waistline.
translated_content: 앨런 휴커는 기이한 엘리트들을 날카롭고 유머러스하게 탐구한 유명한 영국 저널리스트이자 다큐멘터리 제작자였다. 그는 평생을 조용히 사생활을 지키며, 특히 마지막 해들 동안 그렇게 보냈다. 할리우드가 젊음에 집착하는 이야기를 시청자들에게 들려주면서도, 그는 단순한 진실을 숨겼다: 자신은 공개적으로 말한 것보다 더 나이가 많았다. 공식 기록과 휴커의 『위크스위』, 그리고 BBC의 장례 발표에서는 출생 연도를 1925년으로 기재해 사망 당시 87세라고 했지만, 실제로 그는 1921년 8월 2일에 태어나 91세로 세상을 떠났다. 건강이 악화되면서 그는 44년간의 파트너인 밸러리 클리먼과 함께 제레시의 자택으로 은퇴했으며, 그녀는 24살이 더 어렸다. 휴커는 한때 블론드, 브라운헤어, 레드헤어를 각각 두 명씩 데리고 싶다고 농담했지만, 진정한 사랑은 밸러리에게 있었다. 그녀는 그의 여행 책을 촬영하고 후기 다큐멘터리를 제작했다. 그의 나이 숨김은 악의적인 것이 아니라, 외모에 집착하는 산업에 대한 조용한 풍자 같았다. 비슷한 사례는 많다. 조안 콜린스는 80세가 되자 『위크스위』에서 자신의 출생 연도를 삭제했고, 요리사 앤토니 워럴 톰슨은 정신과 치료를 받았음에도 불구하고 왜 슈퍼마켓에서 물건을 훔쳤는지 여전히 알지 못했다. 한편, 마치 로드 마치의 딸인 앳티 고든-렌녹은 굵은 머리카락을 반만 깎아내고 굿우드 페스티벌 오브 스피드에 등장해 모두를 놀라게 했다. 그녀는 ‘단지 재미로 한 일’이라고 말했다. 아버지는 그녀를 매우 따뜻하게 대했지만, 전통적인 여성스러움을 더 선호한다고 인정했다. 또 다른 흥미로운 일화로, 포뮬러 1 챔피언 댐온 힐은 아들 조쉬가 레이싱을 그만두고 록 드럼연주자가 되기를 선택한 것을 반대하지 않았다. ‘아이들은 말이 아니다. 자신이 사랑하는 일을 해야 한다.’ 힐은 말했다. 한편, 미용사 리 스태포드는 신부인 현실 프로그램 스타 제시카-제인 캘러먼과 뉴욕으로 떠났다. 그녀는 배우가 되기 위해 메소드 연기 과정을 수강하려 했고, 그 결과 맥스 재거는 잠시 자신의 스타일리스트를 잃게 되었다. 그리고 아이러니하게도, 커뮤니케이션 에이전트 조나단 샬릿은 오스트리아의 고급 체중 감량 클리닉에서 1.5kg를 불어넣었고, ‘1만 파운드는 줄었지만’이라고 농담하며, 이는 몸무게가 아니라 계좌 잔고를 의미했다.

article_content: CNN) -- Nobel Peace Prize winner Archbishop Desmond Tutu has canceled all travel for the remainder of the year as he undergoes treatment for cancer, according to his foundation. At 83, Tutu has been managing prostate cancer for years. On Tuesday, he thanked supporters on Twitter for their well-wishes and concern. 'You may know I canceled my trip to Rome for the World Summit of Nobel Peace Laureates due to a reaction to a new treatment for my prostate cancer and bone strengthening,' Tutu said in a Facebook statement. 'The reaction is benign, and such issues are par for the course.' The Desmond and Leah Tutu Legacy Foundation confirmed the update on Tuesday. It remains unclear when or if Tutu will resume traveling. His daughter and the foundation’s executive director, Mpho Tutu, emphasized that this change does not indicate a medical emergency—her father is simply resting at home while his body adjusts to new medication. Ordained as an Anglican priest in 1961, Tutu received the Nobel Peace Prize in 1984 for his pivotal role in ending apartheid in South Africa. He later chaired the Truth and Reconciliation Commission under President Nelson Mandela, helping guide the nation through its post-apartheid healing. Even in his 80s, Tutu remains active through the Desmond Tutu Peace Foundation and other advocacy groups.

article_content: Former England international Ashley Cole has drawn criticism from ex-Liverpool defender Steve Nicol for dismissing Major League Soccer (MLS) as an 'easy ride.' After leaving Chelsea in 2014, Cole chose to sign with Italian club AS Roma over offers from MLS teams. In an interview with Roma’s official website, Cole stated he did not want to 'sit on the beach yet,' emphasizing his preference for a more demanding challenge. He later reinforced this sentiment on Twitter, responding to critics who assumed he was seeking financial ease or comfort by joining MLS: 'I chose to play in a more demanding place and team... why don’t you just worry about your team and I’ll worry about mine.' Nicol, who managed the New England Revolution for nine years (2002–2011) and won the European Cup with Liverpool in 1984 and 1987, called Cole’s remarks 'ignorant' and defended the league’s quality. 'MLS does not want you thanks,' he tweeted, highlighting the league’s professional development and rising standards. The exchange reflects ongoing debates about the perception of American soccer, as elite players increasingly engage with MLS — challenging outdated assumptions about its competitiveness.

article_content: An alleged Florida fraudster, Derek Denesevich, 26, of Lauderhill, pleaded for a lighter sentence after being charged with stealing dozens of identities to file fake tax returns. He claims to have turned his life around. In 2011 and 2012, Denesevich paid a Broward County Clerk of Courts employee to steal driver identities from a state database, enabling him to file approximately 80 fraudulent income tax returns and collect $57,238. Despite having distinctive facial tattoos—including a Bentley logo across his forehead—and multiple piercings, he successfully impersonated others. Denesevich has a lengthy criminal record, including convictions for illegal possession of an alligator, robbery, firearms offenses, and drug-related charges. He says he is actively seeking rehabilitation, beginning with months of laser tattoo removal to eliminate his facial ink. He also cooperated with the FBI, wearing a wire that led to the arrest of six individuals responsible for stealing over 1,200 identities. After police confronted him in 2012, Denesevich fled to Canada but returned to South Florida following the birth of his son. 'I came back here for my son,' he told the judge, according to WPTV. 'I'm extremely sorry to my victims.' FBI agents testified in court to confirm his cooperation. At his sentencing hearing, the court imposed a sentence of one year and three months in prison, followed by three years of supervised release. He must repay the full $57,238 he stole. Porscha Kyles, the clerk who assisted him, is serving three years in prison for her role in the scheme. Although Denesevich is removing his facial tattoos, reports indicate he still has a tattoo on his back depicting his own face—with the Bentley logo still visible on his forehead.
translated_content: 플로리다의 한 사기범인 데릭 덴세비치(26세, 로더힐 거주)는 수십 명의 신원을 도용해 가짜 세금 환급 신청을 한 혐의로 더 가벼운 형벌을 요청했다. 그는 자신의 삶을 개선했다고 주장한다. 2011년과 2012년에 덴세비치는 플로리다 브라워드 카운티 등기소 직원에게 주정부 운전면허자 데이터베이스에서 신원 정보를 훔치도록 돈을 지불했고, 이로 인해 약 80건의 부정 세금 환급 신청을 통해 총 57,238달러를 획득했다. 이마에 벤틀리 로고를 포함한 특이한 문신과 여러 개의 피어싱을 하고 있었음에도 불구하고, 그는 다른 사람들의 신분을 성공적으로 위장할 수 있었다. 덴세비치는 악어 불법 소지, 강도, 총기 및 마약 관련 범죄 등 긴 전과 기록을 보유하고 있다. 그는 얼굴의 문신을 제거하기 위해 몇 달간 레이저 문신 제거 치료를 받으며 개선을 위해 노력하고 있다고 말했다. 또한 그는 FBI와 협력하여 웨어를 착용했고, 이로 인해 1,200개 이상의 신원을 훔친 6명의 범죄자를 체포하게 되었다. 경찰이 2012년 그를 조사하려 접근했을 때, 덴세비치는 캐나다로 도주했지만 아들이 태어난 후 플로리다 남부로 돌아왔다. 그는 WPTV에 따르면, '아들을 위해서 돌아왔습니다. 피해자들에게 진심으로 사과드립니다.'라고 법관에게 말했다. FBI 요원들은 법정에서 그의 협조 사실을 확인하는 증언을 했다. 심문 재판에서 법원은 그에게 1년 3개월의 징역형과 3년간의 감독 하에 있는 석방을 선고했으며, 도용한 57,238달러를 모두 상환해야 한다고 결정했다. 그의 범죄를 도운 등기소 직원 포샤 케일즈는 자신의 범죄로 인해 3년의 징역형을 선고받았다. 덴세비치는 얼굴의 문신을 제거 중이지만, 등 뒤에는 자신의 얼굴을 묘사한 문신이 있으며, 이마에 벤틀리 로고가 여전히 보이는 것으로 알려졌다.
